title: Catalog
description:
What `GET /v1/registry/kinds` answers inside the envelope: every kind control holds. Its
JSON Schema is `catalog.schema.json`, committed, and `src/kinds.ts` is typed by the reader made
of it, which every reader in another language is derived from too -- RFC bq3vn and the
workspace's spec/json.md.

Action.description: None yet: backing up or restarting comes with the controllers, RFC jln34.

Description.description: One kind as the catalog describes it.

columns.description: The fields a list shows first, in order.

named.description:
False for a kind whose resources have no name, a node's and an account's: each is its id, made
by a `POST` to its collection, and shown by its fields and its id's first eight digits -- RFC
32hd9 and RFC o7eir.

plural.description: Its collection's segment of a route, `/v1/registry/<plural>`, so no reader derives one.

choices.description:
What a `choice` may be, or each item of a `list` of choices, each once; empty for every other
field.

editable.description: False for what only control writes.

fields.description:
The fields of each item of a `list` of objects, as an account's `identities`, in this same
shape; an item's identifying field is its first required `choice`. Empty for every other
field.

kind.description:
The kind a `reference` names a resource of by its id, or each item of a `list` does, as an
app's `placements` name nodes; absent, never null, for every other field.

masked.description:
Kept and answered like any other value, and drawn hidden until the reader asks to see it, as
an identity's `value` -- RFC cpc2b; beside its ordinary `type`.

secret.description:
Written and never read back, its value handed to the secret service and answered by the name
it is kept under; beside its ordinary `type`. No field is one today.

Kind.description: Every kind of resource control holds, answered by its name.

oneOf.description: A value of named keys of its own, as an app's `release`; src/specs.ts holds its shape.

The id of a resource of the field's `kind`, as a node's `account`, which the console draws as
a choice among them -- RFC 2kuvi.
